{{Top|leg}}
'''Profiteroles Ukio''' was one of the meals prepared by [[Fidelis]], a [[Tac-Spec Corporation|Tac-Spec]] [[FIII Footman droid]], for [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] [[Whie Malreaux/Legends|Whie Malreaux]] and [[Tallisibeth Enwandung-Esterhazy|Scout]] aboard the [[B-7 light freighter]] ''[[Nighthawk]]''. The meal was served with a caramel ganache filling.<ref name="dr">''[[Yoda: Dark Rendezvous]]''</ref>
